**🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🟠 Major** | **⚡ Quick win**

**Dragging a node no longer moves it.**

`paused` starts as `true`. No code path sets it to `false` now, because `togglePhysics()` only calls `reheat()`. As a result, `tick()` always returns early at Line 914.

During a drag, `handleDragMove()` writes only `dragNode.fx` and `dragNode.fy`. The old code copied `fx`/`fy` into `x`/`y` in the integration step of `tick()`, and that step no longer runs. `drawNode()` reads `x`/`y`, so a dragged node stays where it is. `endNodeDrag()` then clears `fx`/`fy`, and the gesture has no effect. The line `this.alpha = Math.max(this.alpha, 0.25)` in `beginPointerDrag()` is now dead code for the same reason.

To fix this, write the pointer position directly to the node in `handleDragMove()` (outside the changed lines):

```ts
if (this.isDraggingNode && this.dragNode) {
  const [wx, wy] = this.toWorld(x, y);
  this.dragNode.fx = wx;
  this.dragNode.fy = wy;
  this.dragNode.x = wx;
  this.dragNode.y = wy;
  this.dragNode.vx = 0;
  this.dragNode.vy = 0;
  if (clearFlyOnNode) this.flyTarget = null;
  return true;
}
```

**🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🟠 Major** | **⚡ Quick win**

**The initial graph is never force-settled.**

`setData()` cancels any settle but does not start a new one. `initCanvas()` and `renderLocalGraph()` in `graph.ts` call `setData()` and never call `reheat()`. Before this change, the simulation ran on load with `alpha = 1`. Now every force-layout graph opens in the `initialPositions()` golden spiral, which ignores edges. Related nodes are therefore not placed near each other. The item-detail local graph has no Reflow control, so it always stays unsettled.

`refreshGraphData()` also calls `setData()`. A live SSE update therefore cancels a Reflow that the user requested and does not restart it.

To fix this, schedule a settle at the end of `setData()` when `this.layout === 'force'`. On the first load, run `fitView()` after the worker result is applied, not on the 0 ms timer. The `round3-settle` cancellation assertion then needs to check that the stale worker for the old data was terminated, not that no settle is pending.

<details>
<summary>Proposed change</summary>

```diff
     if (this.layout === 'hierarchical') {
       this.applyHierarchicalLayout();
+    } else {
+      this.reheat();
     }
```
